import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/test_0.csv"
        # If there were more sources, they would be listed here
    ]

    # Initialize an empty list to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file, select relevant columns, and append to dfs
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Select only 'Source Zipcode' and 'Counts' columns
        df_subset = df[['Source Zipcode', 'Counts']].copy()
        dfs.append(df_subset)

    # Concatenate all dataframes vertically
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Convert 'Source Zipcode' to integer (if not already)
    combined_df['Source Zipcode'] = combined_df['Source Zipcode'].astype(int)

    # Aggregate counts by 'Source Zipcode'
    target_df = combined_df.groupby('Source Zipcode', as_index=False)['Counts'].sum()

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_35/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
